results.title: The converter watchdog: with both converter slots wedged the probe fails; after two failures the watchdog waits while an editor is open, restarts DocumentServer once none is, and the probe passes again; the probe answers only loopback
evidence: probe before: 200 {"status":"ok","ms":1056}; from the host through the published port: 404 (loopback only); the sample: 200 1277 bytes
wedged 2 converter slot(s) with ADR F17's dropped source; probe then: 503 {"status":"unhealthy","ms":20005,"detail":"converter_unreachable"}
watchdog run 1: exit 1: 2026-10-19T01:33:25Z editor-converter-watch converter probe failed (1 of 2 before acting) (printed for cron's mail: nothing)

watchdog run 2, with the editor still open (open 200, page loaded): exit 1: 2026-10-19T01:33:46Z editor-converter-watch converter wedged (2 failed probes); waiting for open editors to close (open: 1, waited 0m of 15m) (printed: the alert)

watchdog run 3, after it closed: exit 4: 2026-10-19T01:34:17Z editor-converter-watch converter wedged (3 failed probes); restarting ds (open editors: 0, waited 0m) 2026-10-19T01:37:24Z editor-converter-watch restarted ds; converter probe ok (printed: the alerts)
